Marissa / Sally — quick legal summary below (happy to convert to a one-paragraph blurb for your intake ticket):

- Payment terms: Customer-requested Net45 is an open redline. Our standard is Net30; commercial is willing to consider Net45 for committed Dedicated capacity with a revenue threshold. This affects the Order Form’s "Payment Term" field and whether finance needs a billing schedule flag.
- Liability / Cap: We proposed a $3M cap tied to aggregate fees; Cascade redlined to seek $10M. This doesn't change field mapping but may affect approval routing for higher-risk customers; flag on order form as "Requires Legal Approval" if liability cap > $5M.
- Data residency / processing: We accepted a region-specific data processing addendum for EU-only customers. For US-only deployments, default processing terms apply. If the Order Form selects "Private Deployment - EU", an additional DPA checkbox must be presented.

Action items for intake ticket: include a flag for Payment Term override, a boolean for "Private EU Deployment", and an approval flag for "Liability Cap Exception".

Attached: annotated MSA redlines (MSA_redlines_v2.docx). I removed a couple of non-starters and left negotiation points clearly labeled.

-ben

Thanks Ben — that guidance is perfect. I've populated the OrderForm_Field_Dependency_Matrix.xlsx with our recommended mapping and conditional rules. Key highlights:

- account_code (string): required; source = customer portal mapping table; no condition.
- gl_segment (string): optional; if present, map to PO header GL segment; else default to master account GL.
- remit_to_routing (string): required when Payment Method == "Invoice"; for EFT payments this field is ignored.
- vendor_eft_account (string): required only if Tax ID Verified == TRUE. In Ariba this is an "optional until verified" field; we can set validation to block activation unless verification passed.
- private_deployment_eu (boolean): if true, triggers DPA checkbox and routes to Legal for final sign-off.
- liability_cap_override (boolean): if true and cap > $5M, route to Legal staging queue with high priority.

I added two Portal-specific implementation notes for Ariba:
1) Set a pre-validation job to check Tax ID against GOVREG service. If fails, mark vendor status as "Pending Tax Verification" and hide EFT fields.
2) For Coupa customers we can pass a header flag "requires_legal_approval" on createPO which will surface in our intake UI.

I've attached the matrix and a short checklist of API fields we expect from Cascade. Laura (integration) also annotated the matrix with example JSON payloads for both Ariba and Coupa.

Let me know if you want me to push these into your intake ticket or I can attach to the HubSpot deal.

-Laura
